projects.name: Smart Waste Management System
projects.idea: Develop an intelligent waste management platform that monitors garbage bin levels, optimizes waste collection routes, and improves cleanliness through real-time monitoring.
projects.description:
Smart garbage bins with real-time fill-level monitoring.



Admin dashboard to monitor all registered bins.



Automatic alerts when bins reach 80% capacity.



GPS-based location tracking of garbage bins.



Optimized collection routes for waste management vehicles.



Waste collection status tracking.



Reports showing collected waste and collection efficiency.



Role-based dashboards for administrators and collection staff.
projects.problemStatement: Traditional waste collection systems follow fixed schedules without considering the actual fill levels of garbage bins. This results in overflowing bins, unnecessary collection trips, increased fuel consumption, and unhygienic surroundings.
projects.technicalApproach: Develop a MERN stack web application with React.js frontend, Node.js and Express.js backend, and MongoDB database. Integrate IoT ultrasonic sensors for measuring garbage levels and GPS for location tracking. Implement route optimization algorithms to minimize collection distance and provide real-time updates through Socket.IO.Develop a MERN stack web application with React.js frontend, Node.js and Express.js backend, and MongoDB database. projects.memberResponsibilities:
1. Frontend Developer (React.js)
- Develop responsive user interfaces.
- Build admin and staff dashboards.
- Display garbage bin status and fill-level indicators.
- Integrate frontend with backend APIs.
2. Backend Developer (Node.js & Express.js)
- Develop REST APIs and server-side logic.
- Implement user authentication and authorization.
- Manage bin registration and collection records.
- Handle alerts and real-time data communication.
3. Database Developer (MongoDB)
- Design database schemas and collections.
- Store bin locations, sensor readings and user details.
- Manage waste collection history.
- Optimize database queries and data retrieval.
4. IoT Developer (Arduino / ESP32)
- Integrate ultrasonic sensors to measure garbage levels.
- Connect sensors to ESP32 or Arduino.
- Send real-time sensor readings to the backend.
- Test sensor accuracy and hardware communication.
5. UI/UX Designer
- Design user-friendly application layouts.
- Create wireframes and prototypes using Figma.
- Design admin and collection staff dashboards.
- Maintain consistent colors, typography and design components.
- Improve navigation and overall user experience.
